purpose: 登记全部29×20原角色及79同钟背景的原生流量分解，0采集和金融预算，不修改现有源码
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();out=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_native_flow_purpose_decomposition_v1"
parent=root/"reports/research/510300_actual_loan_allocation_full_original_source_v1"
def now():return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(raw):return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def rel(p):return p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
def ref(p):return {"path":rel(p),"sha256":sha(p.read_bytes())}
def read(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name,x):
    p=out/name
    if p.exists():raise RuntimeError("原登记产物已存在，禁止重复："+rel(p))
    p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
def git(*args):return subprocess.run(["git",*args],cwd=root,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",check=True).stdout
proposalpath=parent/"next_experiment.json"
assert sha(proposalpath.read_bytes())=="5a46afdc51d2cbfad18f05815f129186e4f8459cd445e147e026bfb14111becf"
proposal=read(proposalpath)
assert proposal["experiment_id"]=="E117" and proposal["status"]=="PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN"
for p in proposal["parents"].values():assert sha((root/p["path"]).read_bytes())==p["sha256"]
gate=read(root/proposal["parents"]["canonical_source_gate"]["path"])
assert gate["original79_quantity_clock_pass"]==35 and not gate["all_original79_source_gate_pass"]
save("运行前git记录_E117.json",{"at":now(),"branch":git("branch","--show-current").strip(),"HEAD":git("rev-parse","HEAD").strip(),
 "tracked_status":git("status","--short","--untracked-files=no")})
protocol={
 "experiment_id":"E117","study_id":"510300_ACTUAL_LOAN_ALLOCATION_NATIVE_FLOW_PURPOSE_DECOMPOSITION_V1","registered_at":now(),
 "status":"REGISTERED_ALL29_20ROLES_AND79_CONTEXT_BEFORE_NEW_FLOW_EXTRACTION",
 "question":proposal["question"],"parent_proposal":ref(proposalpath),"parent_result":ref(parent/"result.json"),"parents":proposal["parents"],
 "fixed_original_quarters":[r["quarter"] for r in read(root/proposal["parents"]["all29_originals"]["path"])["rows"]],
 "fixed_semantic_roles":proposal["fixed_semantic_roles"],"fixed_original_identity_count":79,"fixed_field_slot_count":580,
 "fixed_identity_rule":proposal["fixed_identity_rule"],"field_contract":proposal["field_contract"],"joint_use_rule":proposal["joint_use_rule"],
 "extraction_rules":{
  "balance_and_yoy":"原E116余额/同比原子直接保留，不重估；缺字段不当零，原摘要/未取得保持不合格。",
  "role_ownership":"在原余额标签及原金额后，至下一原余额类型/原段落大标题/其中或分用途分期限分行业分地区之前；不能借下一借款总体的流量补本角色。",
  "flow":"只原明确一季度/上半年/前三季度/全年/年内或本原季度的增加/减少/新增金额，保存原累计起止和单季度/年内累计类型；多匹配不能确定归属时UNKNOWN，不挑有利值。",
  "comparison":"只紧邻所属原流量的原同比多增/少增/多减/少减且货币单位；百分点是增速比较，不能改成金额。原同比减少量增加的符号按明确多减/少减解释，不计算跨币种比例。",
  "first_semantics":"必须母体/币种/累计期间明示或同原主体章节，不把企业固定资产/经营/工业/绿色等可交叉类别求和。",
  "parsing_copy":"只HTML数字sup脚注和PDF页码在解析副本中移除，原文本/原量/注/时间/响应哈希不改。",
  "publication":"完全沿E11635合格/44未知的自己的原钟；本轮不重新定位或补钟。",
  "cash_and_gross_disbursement":"原未分别报告新发放金额、偿还、滚续/置换及实际经营收现，则各项UNKNOWN，净增不顶替。"},
 "prior_use_awareness":"贷款用途及少数原净增已在旧信用兑现/E114/E116解释观察；不是盲测或原生流量经济机制首次发现。旧月度合并期限及所有金融失败不重开。",
 "request_budget":proposal["request_budget"],"financial_budget":proposal["financial_budget"],
 "all_original79_1711_1212_preserved":True,"all_original79_source_gate_pass":False,"all_original1711_1212_mature_support":"NOT_COMPUTED_NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "current_fixed79_stock_labels_read":False,"new_financial_information_admitted":False,
 "historical_first_vintage_authenticated":False,"independent_validation":False,"expected_deliverable":proposal["expected_deliverable"],
 "completion_rule":"全部29×20角色、全部79映射和有限竞争解释保存后结束同原分解；未拆新发放/偿还/滚续不继续参数或来源营救。",
 "DR007_no_valid_access_preserved":True,"closed_E116_and_all_prior_failed_source_routes_not_retried":True,
 "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"prospective_forecasts":False}
assert len(protocol["fixed_original_quarters"])==29 and len(protocol["fixed_semantic_roles"])==20
save("protocol.json",protocol)
save("全原余额累计净增主体用途分解认领_E117.json",{"at":now(),"protocol":ref(out/"protocol.json"),"all29_20roles_and79_before_extraction":True,
 "new_queries":0,"new_GETs":0,"new_model_fits":0,"current_fixed79_stock_labels_read":False})
print(json.dumps({"E117":"实际事前登记","原季度":29,"原角色":20,"原字段槽":580,"原共同身份":79,"量钟门":"35/79保持",
 "采集":0,"拟合":0,"线性加权":0,"现有源码修改":0,"协议SHA256":sha((out/"protocol.json").read_bytes())},ensure_ascii=False))
